description: Machine-readable definition of a well-formed SAID lane. Read WHOLE (json.load) by said:setup (diagnose + repair a present lane's configuration) and said:install (scaffold a lane's configuration). It enumerates the ## Lane block axes, the required CLAUDE.md sections, the block-shape invariants, the docs skeleton, and the withdrawn axes -- each with a severity class and a self-contained remediation. This file, not a prose stencil, is the single source of truth for the current axis set; when an axis is added or withdrawn, this file is what changes.

severity_meaning.BLOCKER: a consumer HALTs, or a declared gate runs nothing (a nominal pass); fix before the lane is usable
severity_meaning.STALE: a withdrawn or drifted declaration a current lane should not carry

axes.remediation: declare SAID.lane: <name> in the ## Lane block
declare SAID.docs-root: <path>; consumers resolve docs paths from it and HALT without it
declare SAID.code-mount: <path>[, <path>] naming where lane code lives
declare SAID.feature-spec: <path pattern>; the spec-authoring and impl skills resolve it declaration-first and HALT without it
declare SAID.task-log: <path pattern>; consumers HALT without it
declare SAID.working: <path pattern> for per-feature working notes
declare SAID.id-shape: <verbatim shape, e.g. PROJ-01 or PROJ-01-BE-07>; task-id parsing HALTs without it
declare SAID.surface: <medium | none>; there is NO default, so a missing key HALTs every consumer that branches on the surface

a surface-bearing lane names at least one Checker in SAID.reviewers: (read WHOLE), or sets SAID.surface: none; each named id must resolve to a real Checker or the gate reports PASS while running nothing
declare SAID.profile: <code | doc | work>; an absent key or an unshipped name HALTs the implement phase
declare SAID.commands: <gate command>; it is the lane's quality gate, resolved language-neutrally
declare SAID.version: <starter>@<semver> to pin the starter axis set a lane was built on
declare SAID.checkers-dir: <path> ONLY if the lane ships and executes its own Checkers
optional on | off override; absent falls back to the profile's code-review slot
a multi-lane repo declares the SAID.lanes: registry (read WHOLE) on the umbrella block, one row per lane pointing at that lane's own CLAUDE.md

withdrawn_axes.remediation: replace SAID.surface-type: with SAID.surface: <medium> plus SAID.reviewers: [<checker>]; the surface-type enum was retired in favor of named Checkers
remove SAID.project-type: (removed axis); consumers read SAID.surface: instead
remove SAID.contract-face: (never an axis); every lane has both a docs/ux and a docs/qa contract, resolved from docs-root

required_sections.heading: ## Lane
required_sections.remediation: add the ## Lane block carrying the SAID.<axis> keys; a repo with no lane block is invisible to the whole cycle

required_sections.heading: ## Earned rules
required_sections.remediation: add a ## Earned rules heading (one rule per '- ' line, each with an R-* id and a link to its record); an absent heading HALTs the implement phase at close

required_sections.heading: ## Significant ADRs
required_sections.remediation: add the ## Significant ADRs (skill-referenced) shortname table binding each cited shortname to this lane's record file

required_sections.heading: ## Claude Code Reminders
required_sections.remediation: add ## Claude Code Reminders including the drive line 're-read ## Earned rules and name the ids you apply before each implementation step'

block_invariants.rule: each key carries its full scalar value on one line; no trailing comment marker, parenthetical, or aside a consumer must strip
a scalar SAID.<axis> key is named once in the file; the list keys SAID.lanes and SAID.reviewers are the exceptions, read WHOLE
from the first key to the last, every line is a key line; no prose, sub-bullet, stray bullet, or annotation between keys
